_about: Chemical X works used on the Club X reels. Edit this file and rebuild (python3 tools/club-x/build.py). Jim confirms the list; entries marked status:'needed' are waiting on information only Jim / This Is Number One can supply. Nothing here is drawn or imitated by hand: the game loads each token's own art (Hiro metadata API -> cached image or IPFS gateway), or uses the bundle written by tools/club-x/fetch_art.py when it exists.
walletNote: The deployer of brandx, xlove, love-hirsts, cx-tokens and chemical-x-cxlo, found via the Hiro address-transactions API on 2 Nov 2026. Taken to be Chemical X's own wallet; Jim to confirm.

works.name: Chemical X
works.verified: 16 official Chemical X images supplied by Jim on 2 Nov 2026 as a contact sheet; cut into art/official/cx-01..16.jpg and bundled into the game. Titles are working descriptions. Not on-chain tokens, so no Xtrata id and no cameo royalty.

works.name: BrandX
works.verified: Contract found on stacks.gamma.io/collections/brandx; token 1 read through the Hiro metadata API (name Exxon_One_green, image ipfs://ipfs/QmV78nb9A4eCz8v4Srx4tCZ5saA9r2d2PfsaDZyu2agxf2/images/Exxon_One_green.png). Tokens 2-9 are the other eight pieces of the series (3 artworks x 3 colourways) and were not individually read from here.

works.name: XLove
works.verified: Contract found on stacks.gamma.io/collections/xlove (image .../images/XLove_17.png). 50 unique colourways per thisisnumberone.com; these nine token ids are a sample for the reels and are checked at load time (a token that does not resolve falls back to a name tile).

works.name: This Is Number One
works.verified: thisisnumberone.com/collection/the-genesis-collection lists five Genesis pieces (This Is Number One, Mine, So Why Try Harder, Now Is Not Enough (For), Channel #1) credited to Chemical X with Cara Delevingne, Fatboy Slim, Dave Stewart and Orbital; it does not say which is Chemical X's and gives no contract or token ids. JIM: set contract and ids for Chemical X's Genesis piece, then rebuild. Until then the jackpot symbol shows the name set in type on a tile.

pfp.note: A Chemical X PFP or masked self-portrait is used for the wild only if Jim supplies it with Chemical X's OK. Until then the wild is the original plain white mask with an X on its forehead. To add: put the file in tools/club-x/art/supplied/mask.png and set "pfp" here to its filename, then rebuild.
